# SRVCABLE: research brief (as of 2026-09-23)

## Snapshot
Sarvottam Cables Ltd manufactures power cables, wires, and conductors [S3]. In Q1 FY27, revenue from operations grew 18.0% year-on-year to ₹1,248 crore [S3]. Operating profit (EBITDA) reached ₹140 crore (up 2.9% recomputed) [S3], while profit after tax rose to ₹82 crore (up 6.5% recomputed) [S3]. EBITDA margin (operating profit as % of sales) contracted 170 basis points year-on-year to 11.2% amid rising raw material prices [S1, S3].

## Bull case
- The order book reached ₹3,900 crore as of 30 June 2026 (up from ₹3,150 crore a year earlier), and export share grew to 21% of revenue from 16% in Q1 FY26 [S3]. A growing order backlog and export presence provide clear near-term revenue visibility.
- The upcoming Bharuch facility will add about 30% to cable capacity, with commercial operations slated for Q3 FY27 [S3] and roughly 70% of its ₹620 crore capex already incurred [S2]. Timely capacity commissioning allows the business to capture anticipated volume demand.
- Pledged shares (shares promoters have put up as loan collateral) fell from 11.5% of promoter holding in June 2025 to 4.1% in June 2026, while promoters retained a 58.2% equity stake [S7]. Declining pledge levels reduce the risk of forced open-market share sales by lenders.
- Net debt to equity (ratio of net borrowings to shareholders' equity) stood at 0.35 times, with major expansion funded primarily through internal cash generation [S2]. Conservative debt levels keep the balance sheet resilient through industry cycles.

## Bear case
- EBITDA margin fell by 170 basis points to 11.2% in Q1 FY27 as copper input prices rose nearly 14% [S1, S3]. Higher commodity prices directly compress margins if cost increases cannot be passed on immediately.
- Receivable days (how long customers take to pay) lengthened from 78 to 96 days over the past year due to delayed collections from two state utility clients [S2]. Slower customer collections tie up working capital and raise cash flow risks.
- The company received a ₹46.3 crore tax demand order (including interest and penalty) from CGST Mumbai regarding past input tax credits [S6], which equals 56.5% of Q1 FY27 net profit (₹82 crore) [S3, S6]. An unfavorable final ruling would erase more than half of a quarter's net earnings.
- About two-thirds of contracts contain price-adjustment clauses, but these adjust only after a lag of one to two quarters [S2]. Pricing delays leave profit margins exposed during periods of rapid cost inflation.

## Open questions
- **Revenue reporting conflict:** Business Daily reported Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹1,428 crore (up 35%) [S1], whereas the company's official release reported ₹1,248 crore (up 18.0%) [S3]. Official company filings take precedence.
- **Arithmetic discrepancies:** The company reported Q1 FY27 EBITDA growth of 2.6% (from ₹136 crore to ₹140 crore) and net profit growth of 5.9% (from ₹77 crore to ₹82 crore) [S3], but mathematical recomputation indicates 2.9% and 6.5%, respectively.
- **Tax appeal status:** Management expects no material impact and claims a strong case against the ₹46.3 crore GST order [S6], but the pack lacks confirmation of whether an appeal was formally admitted, a stay granted, or a pre-deposit paid.
- **Credit risk verification:** Management reports zero defaults despite receivable days increasing to 96 days [S2]; verified debtor aging schedules and credit loss provisioning data are missing.
- **Current market price:** The pack provides only a historical share price of ₹1,012 as reported on 9 August 2026 [S1], leaving current price and valuation multiples as of 2026-09-23 unverified.

## Sources
- `[S1]` Business Daily Online, 2026-08-09: Sarvottam Cables' Q1 revenue jumps 35%, but copper costs bite into margins (https://businessdaily.example/markets/sarvottam-cables-q1-results)
- `[S2]` Sarvottam Cables Ltd IR, 2026-08-11: Q1 FY27 earnings conference call: excerpt (https://ir.sarvottamcables.example/transcripts/q1fy27.pdf)
- `[S3]` Sarvottam Cables Ltd IR, 2026-08-08: Sarvottam Cables Ltd announces Q1 FY27 results (https://ir.sarvottamcables.example/press/q1fy27)
- `[S6]` NSE corporate announcement, 2026-09-02: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations: receipt of GST demand order (https://nse.example/announcements/SRVCABLE/2026-09-02)
- `[S7]` NSE shareholding pattern filing, 2026-07-15: Sarvottam Cables Ltd: shareholding pattern as of 30 June 2026 (https://nse.example/shareholding/SRVCABLE/2026-06)

### Excluded or downweighted
- `[S4]` Market Watch India, 2024-03-18: Downweighted as stale; its March 2024 promoter pledge figure of 35% has been superseded by the June 2026 regulatory filing [S7].
- `[S5]` Local news report: Excluded; discusses an unrelated Nagpur broadband provider rather than the listed company.

_This is a summary of the provided documents, not investment advice._
